description: Widens a domain's base type, which is the one domain change with no in-place form: the domain is dropped and recreated. Nothing is typed by it here, so the recreate is free to happen — which is what keeps DropDomain and CreateDomain exercised. The in-use case, where the recreate cannot happen at all, is domain-retype-in-use.

sqlite.because: SQLite has no domain type, so the scenario's bootstrap state cannot be expressed.
